    unfold resetAtEff; split <;> exact .same rfl

/-- `Reachable` is closed under its steps (MM-03.3 §10, `Step`). -/
theorem reachable_step {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} (hr : Reachable k statics s)
    (h : Step k s s') : Reachable k statics s' := by
  cases h with
  | kernel hk =>
    cases hk with
    | derive hs => exact .derive hr hs
    | split hs => exact .split hr hs
    | release hs => exact .release hr hs
    | transfer hs => exact .transfer hr hs
    | depend hs => exact .depend hr hs
    | enter hs => exact .enter hr hs
    | exit hs => exact .exit hr hs
    | read hs => exact .read hr hs
    | write hs => exact .write hr hs
    | writeShared hs => exact .writeShared hr hs
    | pin hs => exact .pin hr hs
    | unpin hs => exact .unpin hr hs
    | endUse hs => exact .endUse hr hs
    | free hs => exact .free hr hs
    | alloc hs => exact .alloc hr hs
    | store hs => exact .store hr hs
  | newArena hs => exact .newArena hr hs
  | issue hs => exact .issue hr hs
  | reset hs => exact .reset hr hs

/-- Finite sequences of steps of `Reachable`. -/
inductive Steps (k : K) : S3 → S3 → Prop where
  | refl (s : S3) : Steps k s s
  | tail {s s₁ s₂ : S3} : Steps k s s₁ → Step k s₁ s₂ → Steps k s s₂

theorem Steps.keeps {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : Steps k s s') : KeepsAuth s s' := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | tail _ h ih => exact ih.trans (step_keeps h)

theorem Steps.fp {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : Steps k s s') : FpStable s s' := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .refl _
  | tail _ h ih => exact ih.trans (step_fp h)

theorem reachable_steps {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s s' : S3} (hr : Reachable k statics s)
    (h : Steps k s s') : Reachable k statics s' := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact hr
  | tail _ h ih => exact reachable_step ih h

theorem Steps.single {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : Step k s s') : Steps k s s' := .tail (.refl s) h

theorem Steps.trans {k : K} {s s₁ s₂ : S3} (h₁ : Steps k s s₁) (h₂ : Steps k s₁ s₂) :
    Steps k s s₂ := by
  induction h₂ with
  | refl => exact h₁
  | tail _ h ih => exact .tail ih h

/-! ## Pool steps are kernel steps (material §4: "construites sur les opérations du noyau") -/

states: `prun` runs a list of operations and returns the final state when every step is `ok`
(`prun_reach`). -/

/-- An operation of the extended machine with its arguments: the steps of `Reachable`
(MM-03.3 §3–6) and the pool operations (material §4). -/
inductive Op where
  | derive (src q : Nat) (m : Mode)
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  | release (a : Nat)
  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
  | exit
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  | pin (p : Nat)
  | unpin (p : Nat)
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  | free (p auth : Nat)
  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
  | store (a p : Nat)
  | newArena (st i : Nat)
  | issue (i via : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat)
  | reset (i via : Nat)
  | newPool (st i : Nat)
  | allocSlot (j via dst : Nat)
  | resolve (j : Nat) (h : Handle) (m : Mode)
  | resolveMany (j : Nat) (hs : List Handle) (m : Mode)
  | unresolve (c : Nat)
  | freeSlot (j via : Nat) (h : Handle)

section Exec
variable (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- `ok` outcome of a step of `Reachable` (MM-03.3 §3–6), `none` otherwise. -/
def kexec (s : S3) : Op → Option S3
  | .derive src q m => if DerivePre s src q m then some (deriveEff s src q m) else none
  | .split src rs => if SplitPre k s src rs then some (splitEff s src rs) else none
  | .release a => if ReleasePre s a then some (releaseEff s a) else none
  | .transfer src dst => if TransferPre k s src dst then some (transferEff s src dst) else none
  | .depend q x => if DependPre s q x then some (dependEff s q x) else none
  | .enter ps ls => if EnterPre s ps ls then some (enterEff s ps ls) else none
  | .exit => if ExitPre k s then some (exitEff s) else none
  | .read a ls => if canRead3 s a ls then some s else none
  | .write a ls => if canWrite3 s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
  | .writeShared a ls => if WriteSharedPre k s a ls then some (write3Eff s ls) else none
  | .pin p => if PinPre s p then some (pinEff s p true) else none
  | .unpin p => if UnpinPre k s p then some (pinEff s p false) else none
  | .endUse p => if EndUsePre k s p then some (endUseEff s p) else none
  | .free p auth => if FreePre k s p auth then some (freeEff s p) else none
  | .alloc pr ow ls =>
    if AllocStatic k s pr ow ls ∧ k.Satisfiable pr ls s then some (allocEff s pr ow ls) else none
  | .store a p => if StorePre s a p then some (storeEff s a p) else none
  | .newArena st i => if NewArenaPre s st i then some (newArenaEff s st i) else none
  | .issue i via region dst =>
    match s.arenas[i]? with
    | some ar =>
      if IssueStatic k s ar via region dst ∧ Avail ar region ∧ IssueRight s ar region ∧
          AnchorOrderHeld (issueEff s ar region dst).1 then
        some (arenaSet (issueEff s ar region dst).1 i (issueEff s ar region dst).2)
      else none
    | none => none
  | .reset i via => if ResetAtPre k s i via then some (resetAtEff s i) else none
  | _ => none

/-- `ok` outcome of a step of the extended machine, `none` otherwise. -/
def pexec (ps : PS) : Op → Option PS
  | .newPool st i => if NewPoolPre ps.s st i then some (newPoolEff ps st i) else none

content.content:
## 39. Execution Frames

`F` is a nonempty stack of identified, non-duplicate frames. Every frame except the initial frame knows its parent. Frames hold temporary authorities and directly local places. The **current frame** is at the top of the stack. `ancestor(f₁, f₂)` means `f₁` is `f₂` or an ancestor of `f₂` in the stack and its call chain.

The base frame, whose identity is 0 in states reachable from the initial state, never exits. An exited frame can neither be the terminal owner of a usable place nor hold an authority that remains active. Frames have semantic existence; no particular runtime representation is required.

## 40. Logical Places, Leaves, and Ownership

A place has an identity, optionally a structural parent, an abstract `kind`, an owner `owner : Frame | Place`, and a logical death marker. Structural parenthood `partOf(p,q)` describes the subplaces of a value; `owner` describes **who keeps the storage** of a root place valid. An owned place may lie outside its owner's direct footprint; ownership and composition are therefore distinct.

A **leaf** is a place with no structural children. `footprint(p)` contains the leaves of `p`, and access rights over a place are evaluated on those leaves. Places transitively owned by a value are not automatically leaves of its `footprint`. A logical unit of the access discipline does not automatically constitute an additional allocation in the elementary memory machine.

A place `p` is **usable** (`Usable(s,p)`) if and only if:

1. `p` exists and is not marked dead;
----
## 44. Dependencies and Effective Anchors

`D(p)` is the set of authorities serving as **validity anchors** for place `p`. An anchor is valid as long as the authority it names is active. Dependencies of contained values are accounted for transitively. Relevant dependencies follow the value during transfer; those of its container do not automatically follow a part transferred in isolation.

For an authority `x`, its **effective anchor** is the root reached by traversing its origin chain. It does not necessarily coincide with its current holder. Lifetime constraints are calculated from the frame of that effective anchor and the frames of places that remain usable. A dependency cannot create a right or artificially extend a lifetime.

`AnchorOrder` requires, for every anchor `x ∈ D(q)` of a usable place `q`, that the frame of the effective anchor of `x` be the frame of `q` or one of its ancestors. `AnchorOrderHeld` imposes the same rule on every **active authority held** by `q`. These conditions apply to the resulting states of operations that move or create holder relations.

## 45. Parameters, Returns, and Reanchoring

A call parameter is an **active derived authority held by the caller** before being passed to the callee; its original provenance may go back to an earlier frame. This interpretation does not require that the authority was originally derived in the calling frame; that additional requirement belongs to Spec 3. The caller **yields** the authority to the new frame: it does not simultaneously retain a copy. If the authority remains in that frame upon return, `exitFrame` releases it; **it is not automatically returned to the caller**. To retain its own right, the caller may pass a **fresh derivative** of the authority it wishes to keep: this is ordinary reborrowing. The definition of ergonomic calling conventions is deferred to Spec 3.

A result is returned by a legal `transfer` into the result place provided by the caller as a `Modify` parameter. Surviving authorities and their dependencies are reanchored by `exitFrame` to still-valid origins. There is no standalone correspondence `M` and no implicit escape permission.

## 46. Arenas as Library Administration States
----
## 47. Initial State

The kernel's initial state contains only base frame 0 and the declared static storage. Every static leaf has its declared initial state, `Init` or `Uninit`. The roots of static places directly owned by frame 0 have a root `Modify` authority held by that frame; a static may also be owned by another static, in which case its root authority is held by the latter. The initial state invents no dynamic allocation, derived authority, or implicit anchor. The initial arena registry belongs to library state and is empty. The initial frame does not exit.

## 48. External Parametric Contract

`K` contains the predicates `DeclaredDisjoint`, `SharedMutable`, `Pinned`, `ExternalDone`, `Deallocable`, `FreeCompat`, and `Satisfiable`. Their obligations are specified in Section 80. `K` can neither fabricate access rights nor remove an obligation of the Charter. The predicate `Invalidates` is not part of this contract.

# VII. Invariants of Reachable States

Machine states are subject to structural, validity, and exclusivity requirements preserved by permitted transitions under their declared external contracts.

## 49. WF3 — Well-Formedness of Frames, Places, and Authorities
---
## 54. Anchor Ordering and Absence of Orphan Rights

`AnchorOrder` and `AnchorOrderHeld` are defined in Section 44. `NoDangling` prohibits an **active** authority from covering a leaf belonging to an unusable place; the invariant does not say that a leaf is initialized. `NoOrphan` requires every active authority held by a place to be connected to a frame in the stack through a **finite, non-repeating chain** of authorities: the first link is held by a live frame, and each active link **structurally covers the entirety** of the place holding the next link. The link need not have an effective mode over that place. `NoOrphan` guarantees neither the exercisability of all stored authorities nor freedom from blocking.

## 55. ArenaInv — Invariant of the Arena Abstraction

`ArenaInv` is an invariant of the **library contract**, not an additional predicate of kernel state. For every live arena:

- `storage` designates an existing, usable place; the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`;
- `internal` is active, with own mode `Modify`, held by the arena value;
- available leaves and issued regions belong to the administered storage;
- two still-active issuances have disjoint regions; no leaf of a still-issued region simultaneously belongs to `available`;
- every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal` complying with exclusivity and validity rules;
- anchor and ownership restrictions are respected.

Arena entries do not, by themselves, constitute an additional storage owner. Two live arenas may cover common leaves when their `internal` authorities are distinct and their effective rights are compatible; no **global** disjointness of arena footprints is imposed.

## 56. Uniqueness of Live Administration

**An authority identity may serve as `internal` for at most one live administrative abstraction**, whether an arena, `HandlePool`, `DataStack`, or another library administrative instance. Before registering a new abstraction, its creation operation must jointly check the absence of that identity from **all relevant registries of live administrations**. Uniqueness concerns the identity of the `internal` authority, not merely possible overlap of footprints: abstractions with distinct `internal` identities are not forbidden merely because their footprints overlap. Library contracts must make the information required for this guard available to the creation operation; checking only an abstraction's own registry is insufficient.

**This guard is not a condition for any safety property in Section 57.** The effective right (Section 43, case 3) already prohibits a second issuance over leaves covered by an active block derived from the same authority. Rather, the guard preserves the **abstraction contract**: without it, simultaneous administration of the same `internal` could cause `reject` instead of `fail`, or reissue a previously released block that the first administration still considers unavailable. It creates neither permissions nor allocations and introduces no general detection of authority cycles. Its physical representation and encapsulation of library registries remain outside the kernel.

## 57. Main Invariant

\[
Inv3 = I1 \land I2 \land I3 \land I4 \land AnchorOrder \land NoDangling
\]

On states reachable from `S3.init statics` under `DDSound(K)`, the kernel guarantees:

\[
WF3 \land Inv3 \land AnchorOrderHeld \land NoOrphan
\]

`ArenaInv` (Section 55) belongs to the library abstraction: it is not included in this main kernel invariant.

I5, associated with pinned storage, remains a **specialized obligation** of `K.Pinned`, not a clause automatically implied by sequential accesses alone. This property is required for reachable states under the declared assumptions. Its correspondence with allocations and bytes requires the refinement defined below.

# VIII. Definition of Transitions and Management of Authorities

The following operations are abstract transition rules. They distinguish rejection by the discipline, defined failure, and a permitted transition.

## 58. Transition Outcomes

Every operation has a conceptual outcome among:

```text
Outcome3 = ok(new_state) | reject | fail
```

`reject` means that the static discipline does not permit the step; it is neither an implicit runtime trap nor `ub` in the elementary memory machine. `fail` is a **defined failure** leaving the state unchanged; **only `alloc` may produce it in the O1–O16 kernel**. Other kernel operations produce `ok` or `reject`. Library-abstraction operations, including `issue` (§77), may define their own `fail` cases. Where such failure is provided, static preconditions are checked before dynamic availability, according to the operation's contract.

An `ok` transition must satisfy its preconditions, apply exactly its prescribed effects, and preserve the relevant invariants. No transition fabricates a permission to make its conclusion true. Holder and anchor changes are evaluated in the **resulting state** when a rule explicitly so provides.

## 59. Implicit Preservation of Modes and Anchors

Changes in effective authority are **derived** from active authorities and their origins; no `Suspended` indicator is mutated. Access operations do not change an anchor without an explicitly authorized effect of transfer, `depend`, `store`, release, or reanchoring. Leaves becoming `Init` do so through a permitted write (`write3`, `writeShared`, `store`, including during a derived `issue`) or a transfer from a corresponding source leaf already `Init`; leaves initialized in `S3.init` are declared as such.

## 60. O1 — Derivation of an Authority

**Preconditions**

1. `source` is an active derived or root authority, and `ExercisableAt(s,source,mode)` holds; its origin chain and anchors are valid.
2. The leaves of `region` exist and belong to the footprint of `source`; `mode` does not exceed the available effective right on these leaves.
3. The addition preserves exclusivity I1: no unrelated active authority becomes incompatible with the derived right, and already-active descendants are respected.
4. The new holding frame is the live current frame. The admissible state's footprint and anchoring restrictions remain true.

**`ok` effect:** A new active authority with fresh identity, origin `source`, requested mode and footprint, and held by the current frame is added. The source remains active; its effective modes are recomputed per leaf. No storage or place anchor is created. Multiple compatible observations remain permitted. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

## 61. O2 — Splitting Authorities

**Preconditions**

1. `source` is active and exercisable by the current frame with sufficient modification rights over the relevant leaves.
2. Each region lies within the available, effectively modifiable footprint of the source.
3. Regions are pairwise disjoint under structural composition or contract `K.DeclaredDisjoint`, subject to obligation `DDSound(K)`; no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped.
4. Creation of the derivatives respects origins, conservation I1/I2, and validity obligations.

**`ok` effect:** An active derived `Modify` authority held by the current frame is created for each region. `source` remains active; its effective modification capability disappears only over distributed leaves and remains on undistributed leaves. Authorities are split logically: `split` performs no physical allocation. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

An unjustified declaration of disjointness may invalidate the proof: without `DDSound`, an accepted `split` may violate I1. Constructing zero-sized subregions is not identified with an allocation of the elementary memory machine; the case of an empty shape in `alloc` is distinct.

## 62. O3 — End of a Derived Borrow

**Preconditions**

1. `authority` is active **and derived**: an authority with no origin is rejected.
2. It is held by the current frame, or by a place `p` on which the current frame has exercisable `Modify`.
3. No active descendant of the authority prevents its release; no other still-usable value may lose a required anchor.
4. If the authority is stored in its holding place, that place is exempted from the check “this authority still appears among the anchors” **only because the effect removes that anchor at the same time**. An anchor with the same identity attached by `depend` to another usable place continues to block the step.
5. Applicable abstraction contracts remain satisfied.

**`ok` effect:** The authority becomes inactive and can no longer be exercised. It is removed from its holding place's anchors when stored there. Effective modes of its origins are recomputed, allowing unblocked rights to return. There is no implicit deallocation. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

# IX. Transfer, Dependencies, and Storage of Rights

These transitions govern value consumption and the controlled movement of their dependencies. A valid transition can neither create an additional permission nor discard a surviving anchor.

## 63. O4 — Consuming Value Transfer

content.content:
## 63. O4 — Consuming Value Transfer

**Preconditions**

1. `source` and `destination` are usable, and the current frame has exercisable `Modify` over their relevant footprints.
2. Source and destination have the **same shape of ordered subtrees**. The `i`-th child of each source part corresponds to the `i`-th child of the corresponding destination part; all nodes are matched. Structural field identity is positional, not an arbitrary matching of children.
3. **All** source leaves are `Init`, and **no** destination leaf is `Init`. The source and destination footprints are disjoint.
4. No exclusive authority is duplicated; validity of derived authorities and active projections is preserved.
5. **No in-place source leaf is pinned**, either statically (`K.Pinned`) or dynamically (`pin`). Storage merely **owned** by the source, which is not itself moved by the transfer of that value, does not prevent this transfer.
6. Dependencies of all still-usable places following the value remain valid; non-escape constraints and `AnchorOrder` are checked in the **resulting state**, including transferred anchors of owned places that remain usable.
7. All moved held authorities, including those of owned storage, satisfy `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state; no authority may escape a local anchor on the grounds that its containing value was transferred.
8. **Local self-blocking prevention:** For each active authority held before the step by a part `r` of `source` whose holder becomes the corresponding part `corr(r)` of `destination`, that authority's footprint contains **no leaf** of `corr(r)` in the resulting state. Transfer is rejected if this local check fails; no global authority-acyclicity check is imposed.

**`ok` effect:**

- every source leaf becomes `Moved` and each corresponding destination leaf becomes `Init`;
- every authority held by source part `r` acquires as its new holder the corresponding destination part `corr(r)`, not indiscriminately the destination root;
- places owned by `r` become owned by `corr(r)`; their roots follow this owner according to `RootHeld`;
- value dependencies follow the corresponding places under validity guarantees; no authority is created or duplicated;
- destination places receive the transferred values and rights without automatically moving storage not owned by a source part.

**Other outcome:** `reject`. `transfer` to a call result is subject to these same rules.

A partially initialized structure may be transferred **field by field**, but only for fields individually eligible for transfer. This does not automatically destructure a value that owns storage **at the container level**: that storage stays with the container if the container is not transferred. Conversion between structures with permuted fields must be handled separately, not as a `transfer`.

## 64. O5 — Explicit Attachment of an Anchor

**Preconditions**

1. `result` is a usable place over which the current frame has exercisable `Modify`.
2. `anchor` designates an active, valid authority representing a real dependency of the relevant rights or storage; a declared dependency cannot extend an origin's lifetime.
3. Existing anchors are preserved and the addition respects `AnchorOrder`: the effective anchor's frame is the frame of `result` or an ancestor thereof.
4. Every dependency carried by a contained value remains represented in the transitive obligations of its container.

**`ok` effect:** `anchor` is added to `D(result)`; the container's transitive dependencies account for it. No additional access right is created. **Other outcome:** `reject`.

A safe interface must declare dependencies covering those actually required by its implementation; the annotation itself is not presumed true. An unsafe abstraction bears the obligations of its contract.

## 65. O8 — Controlled Storage of an Authority
## 80. Parametric Contracts of the Access Discipline

A contract `K` parameterizes rules of the access discipline without fabricating permissions. A safe abstraction using part of `K` must prove or fulfill the corresponding obligation; an unestablished precondition is not a language guarantee.

| Contract | External obligation |
|---|---|
| `DeclaredDisjoint` | `DDSound(K)`: no falsely declared disjoint region when leaves can overlap |
| `Pinned` | I5, prohibition of incompatible physical moves; `StaticPinnedBottom` for pinned statics |
| `SharedMutable` | Applicable shared-mutation discipline, with correct rights and synchronization |
| `ExternalDone` | External use of storage has ended when `unpin` is permitted |
| `Deallocable` | The place belongs to a unit that can actually be freed |
| `FreeCompat` | Opaque deallocation authority is compatible with the unit being freed |
| `Satisfiable` | The provider can satisfy the requested shape **in the current state** |

Structural conditions of `free`, dependencies, and the derived library `reset` carry the relevant invalidation obligations. Physical justification of `DDSound` must be established by a realization consistent with memory layouts and Section 82.

## 81. Boundaries Remaining to Be Specified

This specification **does not by itself determine**: concurrency and synchronization effects (Spec 2); control-flow analysis, `defer`, and by-value calling conventions (Spec 3); representation criteria and typed formation of accesses (Spec 4); representation of library metadata, address width, encodings, and alignment/ABI obligations (Spec 11); or final translation of `noalias` properties (Spec 13). Leaving a rule open does not authorize a safe interface to cause UB; the implementation must fulfill or reject the obligations before exposing the operation to safe code.

# XVII. Correspondence Between Access Discipline and Memory Machine

A transition of the access discipline must admit a realization compatible with the bytes and allocations of the memory machine. An abstract definition of a right does not suffice to justify its concrete representation.

/-! ## Kernel steps with their arguments (§60–§75) -/

/-- A kernel operation O1–O16 with its arguments (§60–§75). The representations written by
`write` and `writeShared` are data of the program (§10 ¶4, §16 ¶2), carried by the operation; the
kernel does not read them. -/
inductive KOp where
  /-- O1 `derive` (§60). -/
  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
  /-- O2 `split` (§61). -/
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  /-- O3 `release` (§62). -/
  | release (a : Nat)
  /-- O4 `transfer` (§63). -/
  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  /-- O5 `depend` (§64). -/
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  /-- O6 `enterFrame` (§72). -/
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  /-- O7 `exitFrame` (§73). -/
  | exit
  /-- O9 `read` (§66). -/
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  /-- O10 `write` (§67), with the written representations. -/
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
  /-- O11 `writeShared` (§68), with the written representations. -/
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat) (w : Nat → Nat → UInt8 × Option Nat)
  /-- O15 `pin` (§74). -/
  | pin (p : Nat)
  /-- O16 `unpin` (§75). -/
  | unpin (p : Nat)
  /-- O12 `endUse` (§69). -/
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  /-- O13 `free` (§70). -/
  | free (p auth : Nat)
  /-- O14 `alloc` (§71). -/
  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  /-- O8 `store` (§65). -/
  | store (a p : Nat)

/-- The `ok` step of a kernel operation (§58, §60–§75). -/
def OpStep (k : K) : KOp → S3 → S3 → Prop
  | .derive src region m, s, s' => DeriveStep src region m s (.ok s')
  | .split src rs, s, s' => SplitStep k src rs s (.ok s')
  | .release a, s, s' => ReleaseStep a s (.ok s')
  | .transfer src dst, s, s' => TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')
  | .depend q x, s, s' => DependStep q x s (.ok s')
  | .enter ps ls, s, s' => EnterStep ps ls s (.ok s')
  | .exit, s, s' => ExitStep k s (.ok s')
  | .read a ls, s, s' => Read3Step a ls s (.ok s')
  | .write a ls _, s, s' => Write3Step a ls s (.ok s')
  | .writeShared a ls _, s, s' => WriteSharedStep k a ls s (.ok s')
  | .pin p, s, s' => PinStep p s (.ok s')
  | .unpin p, s, s' => UnpinStep k p s (.ok s')
  | .endUse p, s, s' => EndUseStep k p s (.ok s')
  | .free p auth, s, s' => FreeStep k p auth s (.ok s')
  | .alloc pr ow ls, s, s' => AllocStep k pr ow ls s (.ok s')
  | .store a p, s, s' => StoreStep a p s (.ok s')

/-- A labelled kernel step is a kernel step (§57, §58). -/
theorem OpStep.kstep {k : K} {op : KOp} {s s' : S3} (h : OpStep k op s s') : KStep k s s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact .derive h
  | split => exact .split h
  | release => exact .release h
  | transfer => exact .transfer h
  | depend => exact .depend h
  | enter => exact .enter h
  | exit => exact .exit h

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Preservation by `endUse` (O12, §69) and `free` (O13, §70)

Both effects only make authorities inactive and mark places dead, then release the authorities
whose holder died (§69, §70 `ok` effects). The shared argument is in namespace `EndFree`; the
per-operation results state that each step preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7), and
the effects of §69 and §70: the ended place stays usable, its leaves become `Uninit`, transitively
owned storage and the released unit are dead, pinned leaves block the step (§69.4, §70.4).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace EndFree

/-! ## Authorities that are only released (§69, §70) -/

/-- The authorities of `s₁` are those of `s`, some of them made inactive (§69, §70 `ok` effects:
authorities are released, never created or changed otherwise). -/
def OnlyReleases (s s₁ : S3) : Prop :=
  s₁.A.length = s.A.length ∧ ∀ (j : Nat) (z : Authority), s₁.A[j]? = some z →
    ∃ y, s.A[j]? = some y ∧ z.mode = y.mode ∧ z.origin = y.origin ∧ z.footprint = y.footprint ∧
      z.holder = y.holder ∧ (z.active = true → y.active = true)

/-- Mapping the authorities by a function that keeps an authority or makes it inactive only
releases authorities (§69, §70). -/
theorem map_releases {s s₁ : S3} {g : Authority → Authority} (hA : s₁.A = s.A.map g)
    (hg : ∀ y, g y = y ∨ g y = { y with active := false }) : OnlyReleases s s₁ := by
  refine ⟨by rw [hA, List.length_map], fun j z hz => ?_⟩

open EndFree

/-! ## O12 `endUse` (§69) -/

/-- The authorities after `endUseS` (§69, `ok` effect): those held within `p` are inactive. -/
theorem EndFree.endUseS_get (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : (endUseS s p).A[j]? =
    (s.A[j]?).map fun y => if heldIn s.P p y.holder then { y with active := false } else y := by
  simp [endUseS]

/-- `endUseS` only releases authorities (§69, `ok` effect). -/
theorem EndFree.endUseS_releases (s : S3) (p : Nat) : OnlyReleases s (endUseS s p) :=
  map_releases rfl fun y => by by_cases h : heldIn s.P p y.holder <;> simp [h]

/-- A place usable after `endUseS` was usable before (§69: the effect only adds death
markers). -/
theorem EndFree.endUseS_usable {s : S3} {p q : Nat} (h : (endUseS s p).Usable q) : s.Usable q :=
  S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := endUseS s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
    (fun q h => by simp only [endUseS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) h

/-- An active authority after `endUse p` (§69, `ok` effect): active before, not held within `p`,
with a holder live after `endUseS`. -/
theorem EndFree.endUse_active {s : S3} {p j : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (hz : (endUseEff s p).A[j]? = some z) (za : z.active = true) :
    s.A[j]? = some z ∧ ¬ heldIn s.P p z.holder ∧ HolderLive (endUseS s p) z.holder := by
  obtain ⟨hz₁, hl⟩ := cleanup_active hz za
  rw [endUseS_get] at hz₁
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hz₁; cases hz₁
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at hz₁
    by_cases hh : heldIn s.P p y.holder
    · simp only [hh, Option.map_some, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hz₁
      subst hz₁; simp at za
    · simp only [hh, Option.map_some, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hz₁
      subst hz₁; exact ⟨rfl, hh, hl⟩

/-- Under `EndUsePre` (§69.3) and `I3` (§52), every anchor of a place usable after `endUseS`
theorem EndFree.freeS_get (s : S3) (p j : Nat) : (freeS s p).A[j]? = (s.A[j]?).map fun y =>
    if (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder then
      { y with active := false } else y := by
  simp [freeS]

/-- `freeS` only releases authorities (§70, `ok` effect). -/
theorem EndFree.freeS_releases (s : S3) (p : Nat) : OnlyReleases s (freeS s p) :=
  map_releases rfl fun y => by
    by_cases h : (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder <;> simp [h]

/-- A place usable after `freeS` was usable before (§70: the effect only adds death markers). -/
theorem EndFree.freeS_usable {s : S3} {p q : Nat} (h : (freeS s p).Usable q) : s.Usable q :=
  S3.Usable.mono (s := s) (s' := freeS s p) rfl (fun _ h => h)
    (fun q h => by simp only [freeS, Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h; exact h.1) h

/-- An active authority after `free p` (§70, `ok` effect): active before, covering no leaf of the
released unit, not held within `p`, with a holder live after `freeS`. -/
theorem EndFree.free_active {s : S3} {p j : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (hz : (freeEff s p).A[j]? = some z) (za : z.active = true) :
    s.A[j]? = some z ∧ ¬ ((∃ l ∈ z.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p z.holder) ∧
      HolderLive (freeS s p) z.holder := by
  obtain ⟨hz₁, hl⟩ := cleanup_active hz za
  rw [freeS_get] at hz₁
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at hz₁; cases hz₁
  | some y =>
    rw [hy] at hz₁
    by_cases hc : (∃ l ∈ y.footprint, FreedPlace s.P p l) ∨ heldIn s.P p y.holder
    · simp only [hc, Option.map_some, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hz₁
      subst hz₁; simp at za
    · simp only [hc, Option.map_some, ↓reduceIte, Option.some.injEq] at hz₁
      subst hz₁; exact ⟨rfl, hc, hl⟩

/-- The place released by `free` is a root place (§70.1, `OwnedRoot`). -/

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.DeriveSplitRelease
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Transfer
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Small
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Frames
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.EndFree
import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Alloc

/-!
# Access kernel: steps, reachable states and the main invariant

Assembles the per-operation results of `Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.*` into the statements of
§57, §58 and §59 of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`:

* kernel operations O1–O16 as data, their outcome relation, and the correspondence of `KStep` and
  `Reachable` with the labelled steps and their reflexive-transitive closure (§57, §58);
* preservation of `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` by every step except `transfer` (§63), and for
  `transfer` the exact condition: on states satisfying the auxiliary `HeldAnchored`, the step
  preserves the invariant iff the destination is usable afterwards;
* `HeldAnchored` holds initially and is preserved by every step from a `WF3` state;
* the initial state satisfies the invariant under `StaticsOK` (§47), and its `Init` leaves are the
  declared ones;
* the main invariant on reachable states (§57) is false as stated (`reachable_kinv_false`); it
  holds on runs whose transfers keep the destination usable (`reachableDU_kinv`);
* §59: only writes and transfers make a leaf `Init`, and every `Init` leaf of a reached state was
  declared or written on the run; §39: frame 0 stays at the bottom of the stack; §58: only `alloc`
  fails.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Kernel operations as data (§58, §60–§75) -/

/-- A kernel operation O1–O16 with its arguments (§60–§75). -/
inductive KernelOp where
  /-- O1 `derive` (§60). -/
  | derive (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode)
  /-- O2 `split` (§61). -/
  | split (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat))
  /-- O3 `release` (§62). -/
  | release (a : Nat)
  /-- O4 `transfer` (§63). -/
  | transfer (src dst : Nat)
  /-- O5 `depend` (§64). -/
  | depend (q x : Nat)
  /-- O6 `enterFrame` (§72). -/
  | enter (ps : List Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  /-- O7 `exitFrame` (§73). -/
  | exit
  /-- O9 `read` (§66). -/
  | read (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  /-- O10 `write` (§67). -/
  | write (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  /-- O11 `writeShared` (§68). -/
  | writeShared (a : Nat) (ls : List Nat)
  /-- O15 `pin` (§74). -/
  | pin (p : Nat)
  /-- O16 `unpin` (§75). -/
  | unpin (p : Nat)
  /-- O12 `endUse` (§69). -/
  | endUse (p : Nat)
  /-- O13 `free` (§70). -/
  | free (p auth : Nat)
  /-- O14 `alloc` (§71). -/
  | alloc (pr ow : Nat) (ls : LocalShape)
  /-- O8 `store` (§65). -/
  | store (a p : Nat)

/-- Outcome relation of a kernel operation (§58, §60–§75): the step relation of the operation. -/
def KernelOp.Step (k : K) : KernelOp → S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop
  | .derive src region m => DeriveStep src region m
  | .split src rs => SplitStep k src rs
  | .release a => ReleaseStep a
  | .transfer src dst => TransferStep k src dst
  | .depend q x => DependStep q x
  | .enter ps ls => EnterStep ps ls
  | .exit => ExitStep k
  | .read a ls => Read3Step a ls
  | .write a ls => Write3Step a ls
  | .writeShared a ls => WriteSharedStep k a ls
  | .pin p => PinStep p
  | .unpin p => UnpinStep k p
  | .endUse p => EndUseStep k p
  | .free p auth => FreeStep k p auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls => AllocStep k pr ow ls
  | .store a p => StoreStep a p

/-- A kernel step is the `ok` outcome of some operation O1–O16 (§57, §58). -/
theorem kstep_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} : KStep k s s' ↔ ∃ op : KernelOp, op.Step k s (.ok s') := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases h with
    | derive h => exact ⟨.derive _ _ _, h⟩
    | split h => exact ⟨.split _ _, h⟩
    | release h => exact ⟨.release _, h⟩
    | transfer h => exact ⟨.transfer _ _, h⟩
    | depend h => exact ⟨.depend _ _, h⟩
    | enter h => exact ⟨.enter _ _, h⟩
    | exit h => exact ⟨.exit, h⟩
    | read h => exact ⟨.read _ _, h⟩
    | write h => exact ⟨.write _ _, h⟩
    | writeShared h => exact ⟨.writeShared _ _, h⟩
    | pin h => exact ⟨.pin _, h⟩
    | unpin h => exact ⟨.unpin _, h⟩
    | endUse h => exact ⟨.endUse _, h⟩
    | free h => exact ⟨.free _ _, h⟩
    | alloc h => exact ⟨.alloc _ _ _, h⟩
    | store h => exact ⟨.store _ _, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨op, h⟩
    cases op with
    | derive => exact .derive h
    | split => exact .split h
    | release => exact .release h
    | transfer => exact .transfer h
    | depend => exact .depend h
    | enter => exact .enter h
    | exit => exact .exit h
    | read => exact .read h
    | write => exact .write h
    | writeShared => exact .writeShared h
    | pin => exact .pin h
    | unpin => exact .unpin h
    | endUse => exact .endUse h
    | free => exact .free h
    | alloc => exact .alloc h
    | store => exact .store h

/-- Finite runs of kernel steps from `s` (§57): the reflexive-transitive closure of `KStep`. -/
inductive KStar (k : K) (s : S3) : S3 → Prop where
  /-- The empty run (§57). -/
  | refl : KStar k s s
  /-- A run followed by one kernel step (§57). -/
  | tail {t u : S3} : KStar k s t → KStep k t u → KStar k s u

/-- The reachable states of §57 are the states reached from `S3.init statics` by a finite run of
kernel steps. -/
theorem reachable_iff {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} :
    Reachable k statics s ↔ KStar k (S3.init statics) s := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | init => exact .refl
    | step _ h ih => exact .tail ih h
  · intro h
    induction h with
    | refl => exact .init
    | tail _ h ih => exact .step ih h

/-! ## Outcomes (§58) and the base frame (§39) -/

/-- Only `alloc` may produce `fail` among O1–O16 (§58). -/
theorem op_fail_only_alloc {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s : S3} (h : op.Step k s .fail) :
    ∃ pr ow ls, op = .alloc pr ow ls := by
  cases op with
  | alloc pr ow ls => exact ⟨pr, ow, ls, rfl⟩
  | _ => exact (Alloc.guarded_ne_fail h).elim

/-- No kernel step changes the bottom of the frame stack (§39: the base frame never exits). -/
theorem kstep_base {k : K} {s s' : S3} (h : KStep k s s') : s'.F.getLast? = s.F.getLast? := by
  cases h with
  | derive h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | split h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | release h =>
    rename_i a
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl
  | transfer h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | depend h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | enter h => exact enter_keeps_base h
  | exit h => exact (exit_keeps_base h).2
  | read h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | write h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | writeShared h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | pin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | unpin h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | endUse h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | free h => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; rfl
  | alloc h => cases h with | ok => rfl
  | store h =>
    rename_i a p
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    unfold storeEff; split <;> rfl

/-- On every reachable state, the bottom of the stack is the base frame 0 (§39, §47). -/
theorem reachable_base {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    s.F.getLast? = some 0 := by
  induction h with
  | init => rfl
  | step _ h ih => rw [kstep_base h]; exact ih

/-- The base frame 0 is never removed from the stack of a reachable state (§39). -/
theorem reachable_base_mem {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (h : Reachable k statics s) :
    0 ∈ s.F :=
  List.mem_of_getLast? (reachable_base h)

/-! ## Preservation by every step except `transfer` (§57, §58) -/

/-- Every operation other than `transfer` preserves `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7) from its
`ok` outcome, under `DDSound` (§80, used by `split`, §61). -/
theorem op_preserves {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s)
    (haux : KAux s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) (hnt : ∀ src dst, op ≠ .transfer src dst) :
    KInv s' ∧ KAux s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive => exact derive_preserves hinv haux h
  | split => exact split_preserves hdd hinv haux h
  | release => exact release_preserves hinv haux h
  | transfer src dst => exact absurd rfl (hnt src dst)
  | depend => exact depend_preserves hinv haux h
  | enter => exact enter_preserves hinv haux h
  | exit => exact exit_preserves hinv haux h
  | read => exact read_preserves hinv haux h
  | write => exact write_preserves hinv haux h
  | writeShared => exact writeShared_preserves hinv haux h
  | pin => exact pin_preserves hinv haux h
  | unpin => exact unpin_preserves hinv haux h
  | endUse => exact endUse_preserves hinv haux h
  | free => exact free_preserves hinv haux h
  | alloc => exact alloc_preserves hinv haux h
  | store => exact store_preserves hinv haux h

/-- Every kernel step from a state satisfying `KInv` (§57) and `KAux` (§40, §49.7) under `DDSound`
(§80) either preserves both or is an accepted `transfer` (§63), the one exception
(`transfer_breaks_kinv`). -/
theorem kstep_preserves {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k) (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (h : KStep k s s') :
    (KInv s' ∧ KAux s') ∨ ∃ src dst, TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s') := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  cases op with
  | transfer src dst => exact .inr ⟨src, dst, hop⟩
  | _ => exact .inl (op_preserves hdd hinv haux hop fun _ _ e => KernelOp.noConfusion e)

/-! ## `HeldAnchored` is preserved by every step (§44, §65, §63) -/

/-- An active derived authority of the resulting state held by place `q` is an anchor of `q`
(§44), or it was already such an authority before the step and the step keeps the anchors of `q`
when `q` was usable (§52). Under `WF3` (§49.8) this gives `HeldAnchored` after the step. -/
private theorem heldAnchored_of_step {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
    (hstep : ∀ x y q, s'.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true → y.origin ≠ none →
      y.holder = .place q → x ∈ s'.D q ∨ ∃ y₀ : Authority, s.A[x]? = some y₀ ∧
        y₀.active = true ∧ y₀.origin ≠ none ∧ y₀.holder = .place q ∧
        (s.Usable q → x ∈ s.D q → x ∈ s'.D q)) : HeldAnchored s' := by
  intro x y q hy ya ho hhq _
  rcases hstep x y q hy ya ho hhq with h | ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya₀, ho₀, hh₀, himp⟩
  · exact h
  · have hu : s.Usable q := by have := hw.holders x y₀ hy₀ ya₀; rw [hh₀] at this; exact this
    exact himp hu (hh x y₀ q hy₀ ya₀ ho₀ hh₀ hu)

/-- An element of an appended list comes from one of the two parts (§42: authorities added by
`derive`, `split`, `enterFrame`, `alloc`). -/
private theorem getElem?_append_cases {α : Type} {l E : List α} {x : Nat} {y : α}
    (h : (l ++ E)[x]? = some y) : l[x]? = some y ∨ y ∈ E := by
  by_cases hx : x < l.length
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left hx] at h; exact .inl h
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega)] at h; exact .inr (List.mem_of_getElem? h)

/-- Every operation preserves `HeldAnchored` from a `WF3` state (§44; §60–§75 `ok` effects): new
authorities are held by frames or have no origin; `store` anchors what it stores (§65); a
`transfer` moves an authority with the anchors of its holder (§63); `exitFrame` maps a surviving
anchor to itself (§73); the other steps only release authorities or keep the anchors of the
places whose authorities stay active. -/
theorem op_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s)
    (hh : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) : HeldAnchored s' := by
  cases op with
  | derive src region m =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
    rcases addAuth_get hy with ⟨-, hy⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
    · cases hhq
  | split src rs =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
    rcases getElem?_append_cases hy with hy | hy
    · exact .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
    · obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; cases hhq
  | release a =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    cases hx₀ : s.A[a]? with
    | none => simp only [releaseEff, hx₀]; exact hh
    | some x₀ =>
      rw [releaseEff_eq hx₀]
      refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
      simp only [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hx₀)] at hy
      split at hy
      · cases hy; cases ya
      · rename_i hax
        refine .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
        simp only
        split
        · exact List.mem_filter.2 ⟨hx, by simpa using fun e => hax e.symm⟩
        · exact hx
  | transfer src dst => exact transfer_preserves_heldAnchored hw hh h
  | depend q₀ x₀ =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq,
      fun _ hx => ?_⟩
    simp only [dependEff]
    split
    · rename_i e; subst e; exact List.mem_append_left _ hx
    · exact hx
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
    rcases getElem?_append_cases hy with hy | hy
    · rw [getElem?_mapI] at hy
      obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
      split at e
      · subst e; cases hhq
      · subst e
        refine .inr ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya, ho, hhq, fun hu hx => ?_⟩
        simp only [enterEff, if_neg (Nat.not_le.2 hu.lt)]; exact hx
    · obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; exact absurd rfl ho
  | exit =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
    simp only [exitEff, getElem?_mapI, Nat.zero_add] at hy
    obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀, e⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hy
    unfold exitG at e
    split at e
    · rename_i hsv
      have ya₀ : y₀.active = true := by
        unfold Survives at hsv; rw [hy₀] at hsv; exact hsv.1
      split at e
      · subst e; exact absurd ‹_› ho
      · rename_i o ho₀
        subst e
        refine .inr ⟨y₀, hy₀, ya₀, by rw [ho₀]; exact fun h => by cases h, hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
        simp only [exitEff]
        refine List.mem_map.2 ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
        simp only [firstSurv, List.find?_cons_of_pos (decide_eq_true hsv), Option.getD_some]
    · subst e; cases ya
  | read a ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact hh
  | write a ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq =>
      .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
  | writeShared a ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq =>
      .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
  | pin p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq =>
      .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
  | unpin p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    exact heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq =>
      .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
  | endUse p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
    obtain ⟨hy₀, hnh, -⟩ := EndFree.endUse_active hy ya
    refine .inr ⟨y, hy₀, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
    rw [hhq] at hnh
    show x ∈ (if partOf s.P q p then [] else s.D q)
    rw [if_neg hnh]; exact hx
  | free p auth =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
    obtain ⟨hy₀, -, -⟩ := EndFree.free_active hy ya
    exact .inr ⟨y, hy₀, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => hx⟩
  | alloc pr ow ls =>
    cases h with
    | ok _ _ =>
      refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
      rcases getElem?_append_cases hy with hy | hy
      · refine .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun hu hx => ?_⟩
        simp only [allocEff, if_neg (Nat.not_le.2 hu.lt)]; exact hx
      · obtain ⟨r, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy; exact absurd rfl ho
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    cases hy₁ : s.A[a]? with
    | none => simp only [storeEff, hy₁]; exact hh
    | some y₁ =>
      have heq : storeEff s a p = { s with
          A := s.A.set a { y₁ with holder := .place p }
          D := fun q => if q = p then s.D p ++ [a] else s.D q
          I := fun l => if l = p then .init else s.I l } := by
        simp only [storeEff, hy₁]
      rw [heq]
      refine heldAnchored_of_step hw hh fun x y q hy ya ho hhq => ?_
      simp only [set_get (lt_of_getElem? hy₁)] at hy
      split at hy
      · rename_i e; subst e; cases hy
        cases hhq
        exact .inl (by simp)
      · refine .inr ⟨y, hy, ya, ho, hhq, fun _ hx => ?_⟩
        simp only
        split
        · rename_i e; subst e; exact List.mem_append_left _ hx
        · exact hx

/-- `HeldAnchored` is preserved by every kernel step from a `WF3` state (§44, §49, §57). -/
theorem kstep_preserves_heldAnchored {k : K} {s s' : S3} (hw : WF3 s) (hh : HeldAnchored s)
    (h : KStep k s s') : HeldAnchored s' := by
  obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 h
  exact op_preserves_heldAnchored hw hh hop

/-! ## The transfer step (§63, §57) -/

/-- On a state satisfying `KInv` (§57), `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and `HeldAnchored` (auxiliary, not a
clause of §63 nor of §57), an accepted `transfer` (§63) preserves `KInv ∧ KAux` iff its
destination is usable in the resulting state. The destination usable afterwards is not a clause of
§63 (`transfer_breaks_kinv`); this states exactly when §57 holds after the step. -/
theorem transfer_kinv_iff {k : K} {s s' : S3} {src dst : Nat} (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s)
    (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : TransferStep k src dst s (.ok s')) :
    KInv s' ∧ KAux s' ↔ s'.Usable dst := by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨hi', _⟩ => ?_, transfer_preserves_of_dst_usable_of_heldAnchored hinv haux hheld h⟩
  obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
  refine Decidable.byContradiction fun hu => ?_
  obtain ⟨a, -, -, hall⟩ := hpre.dstRight
  obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := exists_mem_footprint hinv.1 (s.P.length - dst + 1) dst (by omega)
    hpre.dstUsable.lt
  have hal := hall l hl
  cases he : effective s a l with
  | none => rw [he] at hal; exact hal
  | some e =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, xa, hlx, -⟩ := effective_some he
    have hx' : (transferEff s src dst).A[a]? = some
        (if heldIn s.P src x.holder then { x with holder := mvTo s.P src dst x.holder } else x) := by
      rw [transfer_A_get, hx]; rfl
    exact hi'.2.1.2.2 a _ hx' (by split <;> exact xa) dst hu l
      (by rw [transfer_footprint]; exact hl) (by split <;> exact hlx)

/-- Every operation, `transfer` included when its destination stays usable (a hypothesis, not a
clause of §63), preserves `KInv` (§57), `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and `HeldAnchored` (auxiliary) under
`DDSound` (§80). -/
theorem op_preserves_of_dst_usable {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hinv : KInv s) (haux : KAux s) (hheld : HeldAnchored s) (h : op.Step k s (.ok s'))
    (hdu : ∀ src dst, op = .transfer src dst → s'.Usable dst) :
    KInv s' ∧ KAux s' ∧ HeldAnchored s' := by
  have hh' := op_preserves_heldAnchored hinv.1 hheld h
  cases op with
  | transfer src dst =>
    exact ⟨(transfer_kinv_iff hinv haux hheld h).2 (hdu src dst rfl), hh'⟩
  | _ =>
    exact ⟨op_preserves hdd hinv haux h fun _ _ e => KernelOp.noConfusion e, hh'⟩

/-! ## The initial state (§47) -/

/-- The places of `S3.init statics` are the declared statics (§47). -/
private theorem initP_len (statics : Statics) : (S3.init statics).P.length = statics.length := by
  simp [S3.init, shapeP]

/-- The place of a static (§47): its declared parent, its owner (the owning static or frame 0),
its kind. -/
private theorem initP_get {statics : Statics} {i : Nat} (hi : i < statics.length) :
    (S3.init statics).P[i]? = some ⟨((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1),
      shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, (((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
  simp only [S3.init, shapeP, List.nil_append, List.getElem?_map,
    List.getElem?_range (show i < (statics.map (·.1)).length by simpa using hi)]
  rfl

/-- A place of `S3.init statics` is a declared static (§47). -/
private theorem initP_get' {statics : Statics} {q : Nat} {pl : Place}
    (h : (S3.init statics).P[q]? = some pl) : q < statics.length ∧
      pl = ⟨((statics.map (·.1))[q]?).bind (·.1),
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) q, (((statics.map (·.1))[q]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
  have hq : q < statics.length := by have := lt_of_getElem? h; rwa [initP_len] at this
  rw [initP_get hq] at h; cases h; exact ⟨hq, rfl⟩

/-- The authorities of `S3.init statics` are the root authorities of the root statics (§47). -/
private theorem initA_get {statics : Statics} {j : Nat} {z : Authority}
    (h : (S3.init statics).A[j]? = some z) : ∃ i, (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i ∧
      z = ⟨.modify, none, footprint (S3.init statics).P i,
        shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i, true⟩ := by
  simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map] at h
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 h
  exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

/-- A root static is a declared element with no parent (§40, §47). -/
private theorem rootIdx_get {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {j i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx ls)[j]? = some i) : i < ls.length ∧ (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
  have := List.mem_of_getElem? h
  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none] at this
  exact this

/-- The parent of a static is an earlier static with the same owner (`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
private theorem statics_parent {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) {i r : Nat}
    (hi : i < statics.length) (hr : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.1) = some r) :
    r < i ∧ ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = ((statics.map (·.1))[r]?).bind (·.2.1) := by
  have h1 := (h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))).1
  rw [hr] at h1
  obtain ⟨-, h2, h3⟩ := h1
  exact ⟨by omega, by simpa using h3⟩

/-- The owning static of a static is an earlier static (`StaticsOK`, §47). -/
private theorem statics_owner {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) {i o : Nat}
    (hi : i < statics.length) (ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = some o) : o < i := by
  have h2 := (h i (List.mem_range.2 (by simpa using hi))).2
  rw [ho] at h2
  exact h2.2

/-- Every static is usable in the initial state (§40, §47): its owners lead to frame 0. -/
private theorem init_usable {statics : Statics} (h : StaticsOK statics) :
    ∀ n i, i < n → i < statics.length → (S3.init statics).Usable i
  | 0, _, hn, _ => absurd hn (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, i, hn, hi => by
    have hpl := initP_get hi
    cases ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
    | none => exact .frame (f := 0) hpl rfl (by simp [shapeOwner, ho]) (List.mem_singleton_self _)
    | some o =>
      have := statics_owner h hi ho
      exact .place (o := o) hpl rfl (by simp [shapeOwner, ho]) (init_usable h n o (by omega)
        (by omega))

/-- A place of `S3.init statics` is a declared static (§40, §47). -/
private theorem init_lt_of_mem_footprint {statics : Statics} {q l : Nat}
    (h : l ∈ footprint (S3.init statics).P q) : q < statics.length := by
  obtain ⟨hl, -, -, hlq⟩ := mem_footprint.1 h
  rw [initP_len] at hl
  rcases hlq with rfl | hc
  · exact hl
  · exact Nat.lt_trans (chain_lt hc) hl

/-- A root static is a root place of the initial state (§40, §47). -/
private theorem init_rootPlace {statics : Statics} {j i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i) : RootPlace (S3.init statics).P i := by
  obtain ⟨hil, hin⟩ := rootIdx_get h
  have hi : i < statics.length := by simpa using hil
  exact ⟨by rw [initP_len]; exact hi, by simp only [parentOf, initP_get hi, Option.bind_some]; exact hin⟩

/-- Root authorities of distinct positions are roots of distinct statics (§47: one root authority
per root static). -/
private theorem init_root_inj {statics : Statics} {j j' i : Nat}
    (h : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j]? = some i)
    (h' : (rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)))[j']? = some i) : j = j' :=
  Frames.getElem?_inj_of_lt ((Frames.range_pairwise_lt _).filter _) h h'

/-- The initial state satisfies `KInv` (§57), `KAux` (§40, §49.7) and `HeldAnchored` (auxiliary)
for a well-formed statics declaration (§47; `StaticsOK` is a hypothesis, not stated by §47). -/
theorem init_kinv {statics : Statics} (hst : StaticsOK statics) :
    KInv (S3.init statics) ∧ KAux (S3.init statics) ∧ HeldAnchored (S3.init statics) := by
  have hus : ∀ i, i < statics.length → (S3.init statics).Usable i :=
    fun i hi => init_usable hst (i + 1) i (Nat.lt_succ_self _) hi
  have hw : WF3 (S3.init statics) := {
    frames := ⟨by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init], by simp [S3.init]⟩
    places := fun q pl r hq hp => by
      obtain ⟨hql, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
      obtain ⟨hrq, hown⟩ := statics_parent hst hql hp
      exact ⟨_, initP_get (by omega), hrq, by simp only [shapeOwner, hown], rfl⟩
    owners := ⟨fun q pl f hq ho => by
        obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
        simp only [shapeOwner] at ho
        split at ho
        · cases ho
        · cases ho; exact Nat.zero_lt_one,
      fun q pl o hq ho => by
        obtain ⟨hql, rfl⟩ := initP_get' hq
        simp only [shapeOwner] at ho
        split at ho
        · rename_i o' ho'
          cases ho
          rw [initP_len]; exact Nat.lt_trans (statics_owner hst hql ho') hql
        · cases ho,
      fun q hq => by
        obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
        exact ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩⟩
    footprints := fun a x ha l hl => by
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      exact ⟨(mem_footprint.1 hl).1, (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.1⟩
    origins := fun b y a hb ho => by
      obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hb; cases ho
    rootChain := fun a y l ha hl _ => by
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      exact ⟨a, _, i, .inl rfl, ha, rfl, init_rootPlace hi, (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2,
        fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
    rootHeld := fun r hr _ => by
      have hrl : r < statics.length := by have := hr.1; rwa [initP_len] at this
      have hpn : ((statics.map (·.1))[r]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
        have := hr.2; simp only [parentOf, initP_get hrl, Option.bind_some] at this; exact this
      have hmem : r ∈ rootIdx (statics.map (·.1)) := by
        simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, List.length_map, hrl, hpn,
          Option.isNone_none, and_self]
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Frames.exists_getElem?_of_mem hmem
      refine ⟨j, _, _, ?_, rfl, rfl, rfl, initP_get hrl, rfl, fun _ => Iff.rfl⟩
      simp only [S3.init, List.getElem?_map, hj]; rfl
    holders := fun a y ha _ => by
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
      have hil : i < statics.length := by simpa using (rootIdx_get hi).1
      show HolderLive _ (shapeOwner (statics.map (·.1)) (.frame 0) i)
      unfold shapeOwner
      cases ho : ((statics.map (·.1))[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
      | none => exact List.mem_singleton_self _
      | some o => exact hus o (Nat.lt_trans (statics_owner hst hil ho) hil) }
  have hconv : RootHeldConv (S3.init statics) := fun x z l r hx _ hl hrp hlr => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get hx
    obtain rfl := rootOf_unique hrp (init_rootPlace hi) hlr (mem_footprint.1 hl).2.2
    have hil : r < statics.length := by simpa using (rootIdx_get hi).1
    exact ⟨_, initP_get hil, rfl⟩
  have hi1 : I1 (S3.init statics) := fun a b x y p hab ha hb _ _ xp yp _ _ => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := initA_get ha
    obtain ⟨i', hi', rfl⟩ := initA_get hb
    have hii : i ≠ i' := fun e => hab (init_root_inj hi (e ▸ hi'))
    exact absurd (rootOf_unique (init_rootPlace hi) (init_rootPlace hi') (mem_footprint.1 xp).2.2
      (mem_footprint.1 yp).2.2) hii
  have hnd : NoDangling (S3.init statics) := fun _ _ _ _ q hq l hl _ =>
    hq (hus q (init_lt_of_mem_footprint hl))
  have haoh : AnchorOrderHeld (S3.init statics) := fun q hq x y hy _ hhq => by
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hy
    have hex : (S3.init statics).effAnchor x = x := by
      have : (S3.init statics).org x = none := by simp [S3.org, hy]
      simp [S3.effAnchor, S3.ancs, chain_none this]
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfF⟩ := hq.frameOf
    have hf0 : f = 0 := List.mem_singleton.1 hfF
    subst hf0
    unfold EffAnchorOK
    rw [hex, hy]
    simp only [OptP, hhq, S3.hframe, pframe_iff.2 hf]
    exact hfF
  refine ⟨kInv_of hw ⟨⟨hi1, ?_, fun _ _ x hx => ?_, i4_always _⟩, fun _ _ x hx => ?_, hnd⟩ haoh,
    hconv, fun x y q hy _ ho _ _ => ?_⟩
  · intro b y a hb ho
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hb; cases ho
  · cases hx
  · cases hx
  · obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := initA_get hy; exact absurd rfl ho

/-- The `Init` leaves of the initial state are exactly the statics declared `Init` (§47, §59). -/
theorem init_statics (statics : Statics) (l : Nat) :
    (S3.init statics).I l = .init ↔ ∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true := by
  show (if ((statics[l]?).map (·.2)).getD false then InitSt.init else .uninit) = .init ↔ _
  cases statics[l]? with
  | none => simp
  | some e => cases he : e.2 <;> simp [he]

/-! ## Reachable states (§57) -/

/-- §57 as stated is false: under a contract satisfying `DDSound` (§80) and well-formed statics
(§47), a reachable state violates `KInv`, after an accepted `transfer` (§63,
`transfer_breaks_kinv`). -/
theorem reachable_kinv_false : ¬ ∀ (k : K) (statics : Statics) (s : S3), DDSound k →
    StaticsOK statics → Reachable k statics s → KInv s := by
  intro hall
  obtain ⟨hdd, s, s', hr, -, -, ht, hn⟩ := transfer_breaks_kinv
  exact hn (hall _ _ _ hdd (by decide) (.step hr (.transfer ht)))

/-- A kernel step whose `transfer`, if it is one, leaves its destination usable (§63). The
condition is a hypothesis on runs, not a clause of §63 nor of §57. -/
def KStepDU (k : K) (s s' : S3) : Prop :=
  ∃ op : KernelOp, op.Step k s (.ok s') ∧ ∀ src dst, op = .transfer src dst → s'.Usable dst

/-- States reached from `S3.init statics` by runs whose transfers keep the destination usable
(§57, restricted by the hypothesis of `KStepDU`, which is not a clause of §63). -/
inductive ReachableDU (k : K) (statics : Statics) : S3 → Prop where
  /-- The initial state (§47). -/
  | init : ReachableDU k statics (S3.init statics)
  /-- One more step of `KStepDU` (§57). -/
  | step {s s' : S3} : ReachableDU k statics s → KStepDU k s s' → ReachableDU k statics s'

/-- A state of `ReachableDU` is reachable (§57). -/
theorem ReachableDU.reachable {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3}
    (h : ReachableDU k statics s) : Reachable k statics s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact .init
  | step _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨op, hop, -⟩ := h
    exact .step ih (kstep_iff.2 ⟨op, hop⟩)

/-- The main invariant of §57 (`WF3 ∧ Inv3 ∧ AnchorOrderHeld ∧ NoOrphan`, with `KAux` and
`HeldAnchored`) on the states reached by runs whose transfers keep the destination usable, under
`DDSound` (§80) and well-formed statics (`StaticsOK`, a hypothesis not stated by §47). The
restriction of the runs is not a clause of §63: without it the statement is false
(`reachable_kinv_false`). -/
theorem reachableDU_kinv {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} (hdd : DDSound k)
    (hst : StaticsOK statics) (h : ReachableDU k statics s) :
    KInv s ∧ KAux s ∧ HeldAnchored s := by
  induction h with
  | init => exact init_kinv hst
  | step _ h ih =>
    obtain ⟨op, hop, hdu⟩ := h
    exact op_preserves_of_dst_usable hdd ih.1 ih.2.1 ih.2.2 hop hdu

/-! ## Initialization history (§59) -/

/-- Operation `op` writes leaf `l` from state `s` (§59): `write3` or `writeShared` of a list
containing `l`, `store` into `l`, or a `transfer` of which `l` is a destination leaf
corresponding to a source leaf `Init` before the step. -/
def KernelOp.Writes (s : S3) (l : Nat) : KernelOp → Prop
  | .write _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .writeShared _ ls => l ∈ ls
  | .store _ p => l = p
  | .transfer src dst => l ∈ footprint s.P dst ∧
      ∃ l' ∈ footprint s.P src, corr s.P src dst l' = some l ∧ s.I l' = .init
  | _ => False

/-- In every `ok` step, a leaf that becomes `Init` is written by the step (§59): a permitted write
(`write3`, `writeShared`, `store`) or a transfer from a corresponding source leaf already
`Init`. -/
theorem init_only_by_writes {k : K} {op : KernelOp} {s s' : S3} {l : Nat}
    (h : op.Step k s (.ok s')) (hl : s.I l ≠ .init) (hl' : s'.I l = .init) : op.Writes s l := by
  cases op with
  | derive => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | split => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | release a =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    unfold releaseEff at hl'; split at hl' <;> exact absurd hl' hl
  | transfer src dst =>
    obtain ⟨hpre, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (transferEff s src dst).I l = if l ∈ footprint s.P dst then .init
        else if l ∈ footprint s.P src then .moved else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'
    split at hl'
    · rename_i hld
      obtain ⟨hlP, hleaf, hlp⟩ := mem_footprint.1 hld
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hrs, hc⟩ := hpre.sameShape.2 l (List.mem_range.2 hlP) hlp
      have h1 := hpre.sameShape.1 r hr hrs
      rw [hc] at h1
      have hkr : kids s.P r = [] := by
        have : (kids s.P l).length = 0 := by rw [kids_nil_iff.2 hleaf]; rfl
        exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by simp only [OptP] at h1; omega)
      have hrf : r ∈ footprint s.P src :=
        mem_footprint.2 ⟨List.mem_range.1 hr, kids_nil_iff.1 hkr, hrs⟩
      exact ⟨hld, r, hrf, hc, hpre.srcInit r hrf⟩
    · split at hl'
      · cases hl'
      · exact absurd hl' hl
  | depend => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | enter ps ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (enterEff s ps ls).I l = if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · cases hl'
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | exit => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | read => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | write a ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (write3Eff s ls).I l = if l ∈ ls then .init else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · assumption
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | writeShared a ls =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (write3Eff s ls).I l = if l ∈ ls then .init else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · assumption
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | pin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | unpin => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | endUse p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    have e : (endUseEff s p).I l = if l ∈ footprint s.P p then .uninit else s.I l := rfl
    rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
    · cases hl'
    · exact absurd hl' hl
  | free => obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h; exact absurd hl' hl
  | alloc pr ow ls =>
    cases h with
    | ok _ _ =>
      have e : (allocEff s ow ls).I l = if s.P.length ≤ l then .uninit else s.I l := rfl
      rw [e] at hl'; split at hl'
      · cases hl'
      · exact absurd hl' hl
  | store a p =>
    obtain ⟨-, rfl⟩ := Guarded.ok_iff.1 h
    show l = p
    refine Decidable.byContradiction fun ne => hl ?_
    unfold storeEff at hl'
    split at hl'
    · simpa [ne] using hl'
    · exact hl'

/-- Every `Init` leaf of a state reached by a run from `S3.init statics` was declared `Init`
(§47) or was made `Init` by a write step of that run (§59): a step `t → t'` of the run, through
an operation writing the leaf, after which the run continues from `t'` to the final state. -/
theorem init_history {k : K} {statics : Statics} {s : S3} {l : Nat}
    (h : KStar k (S3.init statics) s) (hl : s.I l = .init) :
    (∃ e, statics[l]? = some e ∧ e.2 = true) ∨
      ∃ (t t' : S3) (op : KernelOp), KStar k (S3.init statics) t ∧ op.Step k t (.ok t') ∧
        t.I l ≠ .init ∧ t'.I l = .init ∧ op.Writes t l ∧ KStar k t' s := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact .inl ((init_statics statics l).1 hl)
  | tail ht hst ih =>
    rename_i t u
    by_cases htl : t.I l = .init
    · rcases ih htl with hd | ⟨t₀, t₀', op, h₀, hs₀, hn₀, hi₀, hw₀, h₀'⟩
      · exact .inl hd
      · exact .inr ⟨t₀, t₀', op, h₀, hs₀, hn₀, hi₀, hw₀, .tail h₀' hst⟩
    · obtain ⟨op, hop⟩ := kstep_iff.1 hst
      exact .inr ⟨t, u, op, ht, hop, htl, hl, init_only_by_writes hop htl hl, .refl⟩

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access
